title: Map the graph-privacy landscape and select course-project hypotheses
question: What is the evidence-backed graph-privacy landscape through 2026-09-29, and can privacy of an NRI-style latent interaction graph be formulated and tested as a tractable NTU AI Privacy final project?
acceptance_criteria: Build a primary-source-backed taxonomy by protected unit, threat model, release surface, and guarantee type.
Red-team the original H1/H2 hypotheses against 2025–2026 literature and record where novelty is already occupied.
Map the predecessor literature on privacy of topology inferred from dynamical observations.
Formulate at least one precise NRI-style privacy question with an explicit adjacency relation and release surface.
Identify a reproducible synthetic baseline with code/datasets and modest compute.
Do not label an empirical perturbation as differential privacy unless sensitivity and privacy accounting are justified.
Produce a one-page problem formulation suitable for instructor discussion before freezing the final project.
